rows.description: Open source AI clip generator: turns long videos into viral 9:16 shorts with AI moment detection, face tracking, subtitles and dubbing. Self-host free with Docker (MIT), or use the cloud with GPU speed from $12/mo. MCP server and API for AI agents.
Fill-in-your-own-data framework for YouTube / short-form video automation: CapCut JSON + ffmpeg tooling + an onboarding questionnaire. Ships with zero private data.
Creates short videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and a REST API.
